title: waves.canary is the first wave of each stage of the pipeline plywood writes, marked as chant's canary (Forgejo only)

steps.label: main sets promotion, waves.canary and a soak check in dev and prod-us, adds a second project so a wave follows the canary, and plywood init writes .chant/pipeline.ts
the dev stage's spec, folded from the committed file, marks its first wave canary
the prod-us stage's first wave is the canary too

break.note: main sets promotion without waves.canary, so no wave is marked canary: the dev step must fail. This runs on Forgejo only: the bench has no GitHub or GitLab, and those forges' status paths are not exercised.
